in_hebrew.name: Marti
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marti הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Martia, which is a feminine form of Mars, the Roman god of war. In Christianity, the name Marti is associated with Saint Marta, who is believed to have been a disciple of Jesus and the sister of Mary Magdalene. Marti is a name of strong and compassionate women, like Mary, who are devoted to their faith and loved ones.
